subject.title: fix(subagent): resolve runtime model from subagent default instead of parent primary

question: Should spawned subagents ignore the parent session’s interactive model override unless the child has its own direct override?
rationale: Both precedence choices are technically coherent, but this choice changes existing user routing, persisted session behavior, and provider credentials after upgrade, so code review cannot safely infer product intent.

options.title: Isolate spawned subagents
options.body: Configured subagent policy wins, while only a direct child override may retarget the spawned child.

options.title: Preserve parent inheritance
options.body: A spawned child without its own direct override continues inheriting the parent session’s interactive model selection.

recommendation.title: Isolate spawned subagents
recommendation.body: Configured subagent policy wins, while only a direct child override may retarget the spawned child.

likelyOwner.reason: The broadest and most recent ownership trail spans the exact spawn, reply, and session-selection surfaces affected by this contract.
